top_signals.headline: Bank Indonesia Holds BI-Rate at 5.75% to Support Rupiah Stability
top_signals.impact: The central bank maintained its benchmark rate amid global uncertainty, balancing growth support with currency stability. Foreign reserves remain robust at $151.8B, providing FX intervention capacity.

top_signals.headline: JCI Index Resilient Above 7,200 as Foreign Flows Turn Positive
top_signals.impact: Jakarta Composite Index maintains strength driven by banking and consumer sectors. Net foreign buying resumed as EM sentiment improves on Fed pivot expectations. YTD performance +2.3%.

top_signals.headline: Indonesia Q3 GDP Grows 5.12% YoY, Beats Consensus Estimates
top_signals.impact: Economic expansion driven by household consumption (+4.9%) and fixed investment (+5.1%). Manufacturing PMI at 52.3 signals continued expansion. Full-year growth projected at 5.05-5.15%.

top_signals.headline: Federal Reserve Signals Potential December Rate Cut Amid Cooling Inflation
top_signals.impact: FOMC minutes suggest committee members see conditions for further easing. Core PCE trending toward 2.5% target. Markets pricing 65% probability of 25bp cut in December.

top_signals.headline: U.S. 10-year Treasury yields rise as investors weigh Fed decision
top_signals.impact: U.S. Treasury yields rose on Thursday as investors weighted the state of the economy after the U.S. Federal Reserve held interest rates steady.

top_signals.headline: S&P 500 futures climb ahead of Fed decision, major tech earnings: Live updates
top_signals.impact: The S&P 500 climbed to a new all-time high and closed at a record on Tuesday as traders eagerly awaited earnings from major tech companies.

top_signals.headline: Indonesian Rupiah Stabilizes at 15,850/USD on Trade Surplus
top_signals.impact: Currency finds support from continued trade surplus ($10.5B Q3) and BI intervention. Carry trade dynamics remain favorable vs USD. Key resistance at 16,000 level.

top_signals.headline: Indonesian Banks Report Strong NIM Expansion in Q3 Results
top_signals.impact: Major banks (BBCA, BBRI, BMRI) posted 12-15% earnings growth with NIMs expanding to 5.2-5.8%. Loan growth accelerated to 11.5% YoY. NPL ratios stable at 2.1-2.4%.

top_signals.headline: S&P 500 Approaches All-Time High on AI Optimism and Rate Cut Bets
top_signals.impact: Index trading near 6,000 level as tech sector leads. Magnificent 7 stocks contribute 60% of YTD gains. Earnings growth re-accelerating to +8% YoY in Q4.

top_signals.headline: US 10-Year Treasury Yield Falls to 4.35% on Dovish Fed Outlook
top_signals.impact: Bond yields decline as markets reprice Fed trajectory. Real yields at +2.0% remain attractive for fixed income allocations. Duration positioning shifts to neutral.

top_signals.headline: China Manufacturing PMI Expands to 51.5, Supporting EM Sentiment
top_signals.impact: Factory activity strengthens on stimulus measures and export recovery. Positive read-through for Asian supply chains and commodity demand. EM currencies rally.

top_signals.headline: Brent Crude Holds at $78/bbl as OPEC+ Maintains Production Discipline
top_signals.impact: Oil prices stabilize on balanced supply-demand outlook. OPEC+ compliance remains high at 95%. Inventory levels normalize. Range-bound trading expected near term.

top_signals.headline: GM is epitomizing the U.S. auto industry's profit, politics balancing act under Trump
top_signals.impact: GM's ability to walk such a tightrope has been easier to do when it can fall, if needed, onto $21.7 billion in cash to end 2025.

top_signals.headline: Southwest Airlines forecasts surge in 2026 profits after new seat, bag fees take hold
top_signals.impact: Southwest Airlines said it expects profits to surge this year thanks to solid demand and new policies like assigned seating.

top_signals.headline: IBM beats fourth-quarter estimates, forecasts 5% revenue growth in 2026
top_signals.impact: IBM CEO Arvind Krishna said the company's generative artificial intelligence book of business hit more than $12.5 billion.

top_signals.headline: Get caught up on portfolio earnings already out before 2 megacaps after the bell
top_signals.impact: Every weekday, the Investing Club releases the Homestretch; an actionable afternoon update just in time for the last hour of trading.

top_signals.headline: Powell's hard line on White House interest rate pressure is center stage at Fed meeting
top_signals.impact: The Fed and chair Jerome Powell are likely to hold interest rates steady as he faces a criminal investigation launched by President Donald Trump's close ally.

top_signals.headline: Mastercard’s stock rises as earnings send an upbeat message about spending
top_signals.impact: An analyst notes Mastercard got off to a strong start this year, which “defies fears of slowing consumer spend.”

top_signals.headline: Central banks have slowed their purchases of gold, but investors have more than made up the difference
top_signals.impact: The World Gold Council said total demand for gold smashed records last year.

top_signals.headline: Comcast posts mixed quarter as broadband pressures weigh on business
top_signals.impact: Comcast’s broadband business continues to be under pressure due to the rise of competitors, particularly in the 5G space.

top_signals.headline: Starbucks unveils long-term financial targets as Niccol says turnaround is just beginning
top_signals.impact: Starbucks released a long-term forecast and shared more details about how it plans to hit those financial targets at an investor presentation.

top_signals.headline: Starbucks to reintroduce tiers to loyalty program to encourage more visits
top_signals.impact: Starbucks is bringing back its tiered loyalty program.

top_signals.headline: Fed chief Powell says a frail U.S. labor market has stabilized. Low jobless claims back him up.
top_signals.impact: Federal Reserve chief Jerome Powell said Wednesday that the U.S. jobs market seems to have stabilized after a big letdown last year, justifying a decision to leave interest rates unchanged. The latest jobless-claims report appears to support his claim.

top_signals.headline: Altria Stock Drops After Earnings. It’s Losing the Smokeless Tobacco Race.
top_signals.impact: Altria Group stock fell on Thursday after the company, known for Marlboro cigarettes, reported lower-than-expected quarterly earnings and a decline in revenue. The article highlights that Altria is struggling in the smokeless tobacco market.

top_signals.headline: Caterpillar Says Higher Tariffs Impacted Profit Margins
top_signals.impact: Caterpillar (NYSE: CAT) reported record quarterly and full-year revenue for 2025, driven by an 18% increase in fourth-quarter sales to $19.133 billion and annual revenue reaching $67.6 billion.
